title: Fix Overfitting
description: The model memorizes training data but fails on validation. Train loss is low, val loss keeps rising. Apply dropout and data augmentation.

initial_state.architecture_summary: Conv2d(3,64) -> Conv2d(64,128) -> Conv2d(128,256) -> Linear(256*6*6, 1024) -> Linear(1024, 10). No dropout. No augmentation.
training_logs: WARNING: Validation loss is increasing while training loss drops — classic overfitting!

add_dropout_only.message: ✅ Dropout added (rate=0.5). Val loss improved but still above target. Also try add_data_augmentation.
training_logs: Dropout helping — val loss trending down. Need more regularization.

add_augmentation_only.message: ✅ Data augmentation applied (random flip + crop). Val loss improved but still above target. Also try add_dropout.
training_logs: Augmentation helping. Still overfitting — need dropout too.

both_dropout_and_augmentation.message: ✅ Excellent! Both dropout and augmentation applied. Val loss dropped below target 0.8!

modify_hyperparameters_lr_low.message: ⚠️ Lowering LR slightly reduced overfitting but val loss is still way above target. Try adding dropout and augmentation.
training_logs: LR reduced. Training slower. Overfitting still present.

modify_hyperparameters_lr_high.message: ❌ High LR made training unstable. Loss is NaN. Restart with a lower learning rate.
training_logs: WARNING: Training exploded. Gradient overflow detected.

change_loss_function.message: ⚠️ Changing the loss function alone won't fix overfitting. The model needs regularization (dropout + augmentation).
training_logs: New loss applied. Overfitting worsened slightly.

fix_tensor_reshape.message: ⚠️ There is no shape mismatch here. The model runs fine — it's just overfitting.

default.message: ⚠️ Unknown action. Focus on regularization: try add_dropout and add_data_augmentation.
